if (total <= 3) return { kind: 'row', pip: 9, gap: 2 };
  return { kind: 'one', pip: 10 };
why: Four players at four and five stocks lose the one-pip fallback and draw a row of 9px pips. Measured on the real HUD at 390px and UI scale 100%, that 9px row puts a teams strip 19.2px and 63.2px past the topbar's content edge, and an FFA strip, which also carries the identity mark, 34.1px and 78.1px. The fallback -- one full-size pip and the count -- is #838's, and #1055 measured that it holds a teams entry's letter at these two cells with 54.4px to spare, so it keeps the rung. The FFA pips cases already caught this before #1055 (2 tests failed); the teams cases name the teams half of the same contract.
